about: Codes and section ranges to keep. Codes use the Legislature's abbreviations (GOV, HSC, PRC, CIV, ...). Each code takes "all": true, or "sections" (exact numbers) and "ranges" ([from, to) with to excluded). This configuration is the Housing Laws Navigator's: Government Code Title 7 planning and land use plus § 8899.50, the Employee Housing Act, income definitions and four housing-type definitions (§§ 17958.1, 18007, 50675.2, 50801) in the Health and Safety Code, and CEQA in the Public Resources Code.
